facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdpa.test_ParseError: test the python text_format.ParseError exception raised when merging invalid text format input
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdpa.test_Tokenizer: test the python text_format._Tokenizer to tokenize identifiers, strings, integers, floats, and booleans from text

facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdpa.test_ZigZagEncode: test the ZigZagEncode function to encode signed integers for efficient varint protobuf encoding
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/thirdpa.test_ZigZagDecode: test the ZigZagDecode function to decode zigzag-encoded unsigned integers back to signed integers
